reasons.python.grpc: The Python gRPC arm runs the Rust integration harness against the confluent_kafka binding, which imports the changed module.
reasons.python.integration: The integration tests load the same confluent_kafka package, and every client in it imports the changed `_args` module.
reasons.python.performance: The performance tests drive the confluent_kafka clients, which import `_args`.
reasons.python.soak: python/soak/soakclient.py imports the confluent_kafka clients, which depend on `_args`.
reasons.python.typecheck: The change gives `reject_str` a module-level `_TEXT_TYPES` tuple for its isinstance check, so mypy --strict over confluent_kafka has to re-check it.
reasons.python.unit: Nearly every module in confluent_kafka imports `_args`, and `reject_str` guards the collection-of-str parameters that test_args.py, test_string_arguments.py and the admin/consumer unit tests exercise.
reasons.python.verifiable_clients: The verifiable consumer and producer import confluent_kafka and run the changed argument checks.
